context: A uni student and friend chat
purpose: Teach: この方/にくかっ/歩か/外さ/謝る/ムカ/トシ/探り

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 蓮さん、この方、ゼミの先生?
lines.en: Ren — is this person your seminar professor?
lines.style: Gentle curiosity, warm and observant. A question asked without pressure. Noticing a detail about him. Soft, interested.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん。難しい論文、初めは、読みにくかったよ。
lines.en: Yeah. The papers are difficult — took me a while to get through them at first.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly rueful. Not complaining, just being honest about the learning curve. A small nod to his own effort. Quiet reflection.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 徹夜明け、無理に歩かない方がいいですよ。
lines.en: You shouldn't push yourself to walk around after pulling an all-nighter. You need rest.
lines.style: Steady and gentle, genuinely concerned but not fussy. Speaking from care, not alarm. A soft directive that expects listening.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん。眼鏡、外さないで、論文書き続けたんだ。
lines.en: Yeah. I didn't even take my glasses off — just kept writing the whole time.
lines.style: Self-deprecating, a bit wry. Admitting something slightly ridiculous about himself without making it a big deal. Almost amused at his own stubbornness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 指導教官に、遅刻、ちゃんと謝るんですよね。
lines.en: You are going to apologize properly to your adviser about being late, right?
lines.style: Gentle probe, checking in. Not skeptical, but making sure he's thought it through. A soft insistence wrapped in care. Slightly knowing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 査読のコメント、たまにムカつくのもあるんだよ。
lines.en: Some of the peer review comments are genuinely frustrating, you know?
lines.style: Admission of annoyance, but kept under the surface. A small laugh underneath. Wry and resigned — this is part of the process, but it stings anyway.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 同期のトシさん、海外留学、決まったって。
lines.en: Your cohort-mate Toshi got his overseas study-abroad placement approved.
lines.style: Bright and generous, sharing good news about someone else. Effortless warmth. No edge underneath — genuine pleasure at someone's good fortune.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 資料の探りを入れる作業、地味だけど大事だよ。
lines.en: The research work — finding and vetting sources — it's unglamorous, but it matters.
lines.style: Thoughtful and grounding, speaking with quiet conviction. A reflective close that settles on something true. Steady, almost philosophical. Trailing off gently.
